Could be "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury) or "妨害公务罪" (obstructing public duty). He bit police, tearing uniform, injuring officer. That's likely "妨害公务罪" (obstructing public officials) under article 277: "阻碍国家机关工作人员依法执行职务的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役、管制或者罚金。" Also causing injury may be "故意伤害罪" but the act is directed at police while they are performing duty, so "妨害公务罪" is appropriate. The biting causing injury could also be "故意伤害罪" but the primary is obstruction. Usually prosecutors charge both: "妨害公务罪" and "故意伤害罪" if injury. But we need statutory charge(s). Likely two: "危险驾驶罪" (drunk driving) and "妨害公务罪". Could also include "交通肇事罪" (traffic accident causing injury). Which is more appropriate? Since he was drunk, main responsibility, causing injury. Under criminal law article 133 (traffic accident) is "交通肇事罪". So charge: "交通肇事罪" (causing traffic accident). Also "妨害公务罪". So answer: [罪名]交通肇事罪;妨害公务罪<eoa>
